name: UCCS XC Open
where: Colorado Springs, CO · host UC-Colorado Springs · Monument Valley Park
headline: UCCS XC Open: Adams State and Mines meet in Colorado Springs
summary: No. 1 Adams State women and No. 3 Colorado School of Mines women meet at Monument Valley Park, while the men's side has No. 2 Mines and No. 3 Adams State. Host UC-Colorado Springs (No. 7 women, No. 14 men) and Fort Lewis (No. 13 women, No. 13 men) also race. Men's 8K is at 9:15 a.m., women's 6K at 10:00 a.m.
